svg.text: claudia creates — layouts and templates: the preview and the new layout (E10.5, reworked)
Mock round of 22 Nov 2026, for review. Content is invented. “Update layout” is never silent when more than one slide follows the layout:
the preview shows every slide as it will look. Undo is one step, as for every command.
E · Update the layout: every slide it changes, before it changes
Opens from “Update layout · 12 slides”. After shows the result, Before the present state; the changed frame is outlined.
“Right list” becomes taller and wider. Undo brings everything back in one step.
F · Deleting a placeholder: the text on other slides is kept
Deleting the object that took “Subtitle” offers the same two choices. Updating the layout never throws text away.
Remove “Subtitle” from layout “Title slide” for 6 slides
Where it holds text, the text stays on the slide as a free box. Empty ones are removed.
On slide 5, where you deleted it, the object is gone, as you asked.
text stays as a free box
text stays as a free box
text stays as a free box
3 slides keep their text as free boxes · 2 empty boxes are removed · 1 slide is the one you edited
A free box keeps its frame at the moment of the change.
G · New layout from this slide: it exists at once and waits for its name
The same pattern as a deviating style (D75, D309): the layout is made under a provisional name and the person names it when she wants to.
The other 11 still follow “Two lists”. Free objects on this slide stay free.
Compare, with room for the longer side
• is made at once, named after its parent (“Two lists 2”), and the slide follows it.
• takes the slide’s placeholders at their present frames. Free objects stay on the slide.
• that is still unnamed and followed by no slide is removed automatically.
• once named, stays; it can be hidden in All layouts…, like a built-in style (D780).
• is listed in All layouts… with “to name”, as styles are.
Why a purpose question and not just a name: a layout’s name states what it is for, like a style’s, so “Two lists 2” is only a placeholder for an answer.
